note: Private campground and canoe/kayak livery on the Manistique River at Germfask (M-77), 2 miles from the Seney refuge visitor center; est. 1972. The river sites (5-9) sit on the bank; boat ramp, paddle trips on the Manistique and Fox Rivers. Thomas Dambo's troll sculpture Benny the Beardfisher stands on the property (tickets at the camp store). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: $44/night RV/tent sites (2026 page), water/electric (1-4) and electric with potable water (5-9), no sewer, phone 906-586-9801, online booking via ResNexus. Added 9 sites, the ResNexus link, showers/store/water/dump from the operator's map. Cleared derived 75-ft max and pull-through (operator silent). Note rewritten: the old one described ~18 sites with tent sites 11-14, which the operator's current map does not show. Not stated: amperage, season (derived May 1 - Oct 15 left), max rig length.
flags: Season not confirmed: the operator's pages state no opening or closing dates, and ResNexus showed a captcha, so the derived May 1 - Oct 15 (from note prose) was left in place unverified.
Price under US$50 ($44); presence met (live site with phone and a ResNexus booking engine). No gateway within 40 km (nearest Pictured Rocks/Munising 58 km); the family has not stayed here.
